title: Sprint planning dry-runs every paid run a goal names and sets its cap from the estimate before the start gate
goal: When a committed item's goal names a paid run with a spend cap (a smoke record, a probe), plan step 6 runs its --dry-run on the planning host and records the estimate in the item's notes; a cap below the estimate is a gate asked before the start, not mid-run. SP-2vhfsn4o: ST-xy5kmisr's goal said --max-usd 5 for a command whose dry run estimated 23.37 USD; the gate came after the code, and the first smoke still spent 26.62 against a 23.37 estimate
notes: SP-x7ger6vu close (2026-10-09), accepted by the operator: three mid-run surprises a planning run of the goal's paid commands would have shown: the router-only re-record left pool verify (c) failing on the full record's spend row (ST-4w4yo6ca joined the sprint mid-run); host-lookups has no effort setting, so ST-fbp5pm6k's 'both levels in one batch' needed gate g2 mid-run; and benchmarks.py run SCENARIO --dry-run starts paid runs outside pool (BG-wapzksub), so the plan's estimate must come from a scenario that honours it. The planning run uses each paid command's real flags and simulates a partial re-record against pool verify.
